# Finly

> 100% Self-Hosted Personal Wealth & Finance Intelligence System

Finly is an open-source, local-first personal finance platform providing direct bank synchronization without third-party brokers, envelope budgeting, real-time portfolio tracking, loan amortization modeling, and an embedded private AI assistant.

Finly runs entirely on your local machine (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker). All financial transactions, account balances, and credentials remain private in a local SQLite database encrypted with AES-256 Fernet cryptography.

- Website: https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/
- Documentation: https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/
- Changelog: https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/changelog/
- Source Code: https://github.com/louislefo/Finly
- License: MIT License

## Core Documentation

- [Overview & Philosophy](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/getting-started/overview/): The local-first architectural mission and comparison matrix against cloud aggregators like Finary, Bankin, and Mint.
- [Installation Guide](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/getting-started/installation/): Step-by-step instructions for Windows Installer (.exe), Docker Compose, and source developer setup.
- [Configuration Reference](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/getting-started/configuration/): Backend environment variables, Pydantic settings, and client endpoints.
- [System Architecture](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/architecture/system-overview/): Component topology across FastAPI backend, Next.js 16 App Router, SQLite, and Woob.
- [Database Schema](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/architecture/database-schema/): Entity-relationship models for Users, Accounts, Transactions, Budgets, Investments, and Loans.
- [Security & Privacy](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/architecture/security-and-privacy/): Cryptographic specifications, bcrypt password hashing, JWT bearer tokens, and client privacy blur mode.
- [Bank Synchronization & 2FA](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/features/bank-synchronization/): Direct bank connections via Woob, Strong Customer Authentication (2FA/SCA) interactive challenge handling, and reconciliation.
- [Transaction Engine & Rules](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/features/transaction-engine/): Ingestion pipeline, rule matching (regex, contains, exact), and budget envelope exclusions.
- [Budgeting & Cash Flow](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/features/budgeting-and-analytics/): Envelope budgeting, checking account isolation, and interactive Sankey diagrams.
- [Wealth & Portfolio Tracking](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/features/wealth-and-investments/): Net worth equation ($$Assets - Liabilities$$), equities PRU cost basis, and live market quotes.
- [Loans & Amortization](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/features/loans-and-amortization/): French fixed-rate annuity installment calculation, amortization schedules, and early repayment simulator with IRA penalty caps.
- [AI Financial Assistant](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/features/assistant-and-ai/): Multi-provider AI assistant (local Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq) with an in-memory RAG vector store.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/integrations/mcp-server/): Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 tool definitions for AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor).
- [Import & Export](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/integrations/import-export/): Universal CSV parser, encrypted JSON backup/restore, PDF and Excel report exports.
- [Admin Console](https://louislefo.github.io/finly-site/docs/administration/admin-dashboard/): System metrics, SQLite VACUUM optimization, user impersonation, and 15-month demo seeder.

## Key Capabilities & Technical Specifications

- **Direct Banking Connectivity**: Uses open-source Woob protocol without cloud bridge brokers (Plaid, Bridge, Budget Insight). Supports SMS OTP and push notification in-app validation.
- **Local AI RAG Engine**: Indexes financial contexts in-memory during queries. Never persists vectors in external cloud vector databases.
- **Financial Mathematics**: French fixed-rate annuity installment formula $$M = P \frac{r(1+r)^n}{(1+r)^n - 1}$$, early repayment simulation with legal IRA caps under French Consumer Code Art. L313-47.
- **High Information Density UI**: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, dark mode OLED Zinc 950 `#09090B`.
- **Zero Telemetry**: No third-party tracking scripts, cookies, or external analytics.
